d.t: A message or chat on Google Talk, Google Hangouts, or Google Chat.
d.e: Recently, I got a Gchat from Brendan Emmett Quigley, who wanted to run a clue for the answer FAKE NEWS by me — “Indefinite article?”.

d.t: To talk (to someone) via Google Talk, Google Hangouts, or Google Chat; to send (someone) a message on any of these services.
d.e: 2:55 p.m.: Pseudo Gchats me. Looks like he might be interested in hanging out tonight after all.

d.t: To send (something) to (someone) via Google Talk, Google Hangouts, or Google Chat.
d.e: If someone tweets or Gchats you a term you don’t understand, you can just fire up Urban [Dictionary] to find the definition.
